caption: The opened trip card now keeps the live "🚌 in X, Y min" countdown on its top line, worded exactly as the overview row it was tapped from (report #79). Before this change it was collapsed-rows-only, so tapping a trip for more detail took the one live number off the page — the "#316 · 8 min" chip below it is the ride's length, not a countdown. The recipe plans Temple/Grove → Congress/Cedar and taps the shuttle row open.
